name: remnifold
description: Self-hosted, topic-based memory for Codex on Cloudflare

interface.shortDescription: Recall relevant work across projects from your own Cloudflare server.
interface.longDescription: Save completed Codex work to a self-hosted Cloudflare Worker, recall concise indexes by topic across project folders, and open source records only when details are needed.
